The narrow Bull claim expressly described meaningful, qualified protection, not comprehensive retention or recovery assurance, so the Bear has not disproved that qualified proposition. The actual issue remains whether these protections and accessible resources are sufficient after permitted RP/designation/release routes. Repeating agreed legal conditions is not a rebuttal, and missing evidence is Insufficient Information rather than Failed.
